title: Functional score32 exact-partial dual-stream producer before local aggregation
hypothesis: The current score32 schedule-wrapper frontier can only become a hardware-equivalent cadence claim after a functional 2-stream m8x8 exact-partial producer exists at the 128-MAC/cycle wrapper-cluster datapath boundary, emitting per-wave into a 53/54-way local reducer whose aggregate state persists across 8 waves before one c16 global exact reduction.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can we replace the structural dual-stream PPA harness with a functional exact-partial producer that preserves the required 128 MAC/cycle local density, emits per-wave into local aggregation, and exposes the cadence needed for persistent local exact state across 8 waves?
include: functional exact-partial producer protocol, not seeded structural-only PPA stimulus
two streams with m=8, n=8, k=1 and 128 MAC/cycle per producer block
temporal accumulation boundary fixed at the local reducer: per-wave producer emission, then persistent local aggregate state across 8 waves
functional producer max_blocks demand >= 2 blocks/stream per wave, rounded to the supported power-of-two floor max_blocks >= 8
ready/valid observability for exact partial-state cadence and accumulation state
exclude: 53/54-way local reducer implementation in this step
global 16-way exact reduction/finalization changes in this step
OpenROAD dispatch from this proposal alone

remaining_abstractions: Local 53/54-way exact reducer and temporal merge state remain the next unmeasured block after this producer exists.
The existing schedule-wrapper PPA harness remains structural-only and cannot establish exact partial-state cadence.
The current c16 slice proves semantics at 128 MAC/cycle total, but it remains 856x below the frontier MAC density.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure a functional 2-stream m8x8 exact-partial producer block at 128 MAC/cycle, with per-wave producer emission into local reduction and producer max_blocks meeting the 2-block demand rounded to the supported floor max_blocks>=8.

expected_result.reason: The frontier cadence cannot be hardware-equivalent until the local 128-MAC/cycle producer block is functional, emits exact partials per wave, and feeds a measured local reducer/persistent-state boundary.
